speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The key feature of your dizziness being strictly "position dependent" is highly characteristic of BPPV. Given your age, I would like to confirm if these episodes are brief, lasting only seconds to a minute, and if they are triggered specifically by rolling over in bed or looking up.
